briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 launches intensify AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple multimodal models this week while governments debate export controls. Funding remains robust with $11.2B deployed across infrastructure and startups. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate production incidents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with 2T parameters and native video reasoning. xAI deployed Grok-4 on 180k H200 cluster. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama-4-405B follow within days.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across automotive, IoT and multi-agent deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began 2nm AI chip production for Google and Microsoft. Saudi Arabia announced $40B hyperscale campus tied to xAI and Anthropic contracts.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will nation-state compute alliances fracture the open-weight model ecosystem before 2027?
